newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares down, election brings uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares down, election brings uncertainty.

text.p: Norwegian shares fell on Friday with blue chips such as Norsk Hydro and Kvaerner burdening the Total index amid uncertainty ahead of next month's general election.
The Total index fell 0.71 percent to 1,291.58 points in moderate turnover of 805 million crowns.
"The correction has started in Norway. We may see the index falling up to 100 points until the elections in mid-September because of the political uncertainty it brings," a broker said.

Kvaerner's A share was the most traded of the day at 61 million crowns, slipping nearly two percent to 463 crowns following a report the Anglo-Norwegian group appeared to have lost a contract to supply turbines to a Chinese dam project.
Hydro, an industrial conglomerate and the largest listed company in Norway, fell nearly two percent to 403.50 crowns.

"There is a general trend where Norway follows the overseas market down. The dollar has fallen, aluminium prices are down. People have things to worry about after the bullish trading of the past few weeks," a broker said.
